| `stages[].loop.output.select` | record<string, string (1..2000 chars)> |  |  | Extra fields of the loop output, evaluated at exit (context E of the chosen iteration) |

| `stages[].subworkflow.workflowRef.id` | string (1..100 chars) | yes |  | Workflow definition id |
| `stages[].subworkflow.workflowRef.name` | string (1..200 chars) | yes |  | Workflow name (portable across export and import) |
| `stages[].subworkflow.workflowRef.projectScope` | 'project' \| 'global' |  |  | project: the parent's project only; global: workflows without a project; omitted: the project first, then global |
| `stages[].subworkflow.version` | one of |  | `"pin_at_run_start"` | pin_at_run_start: the published version current when the stage starts; a number pins that published version |
| `stages[].subworkflow.inputs` | record<string, string (1..2000 chars)> |  | `{}` | The child's variables, each an expression evaluated when the stage starts |
| `stages[].subworkflow.workspace` | 'inherit' \| 'isolated' |  | `"inherit"` | inherit: the child works in the parent's mounts (its mounts and post-processing are skipped; the parent commits); isolated: a full child lifecycle |
| `stages[].budget` | object |  |  | The child run's budget (its share of the parent's) |
| `stages[].budget.maxTurns` | integer (≥1, ≤100000) |  |  | Harness turns (one per usage report) |
| `stages[].budget.maxCostUsd` | number (>0, ≤100000) |  |  | Provider-reported cost in USD |
| `stages[].budget.maxWallClockMs` | integer (≥1000, ≤604800000) |  |  | Wall clock, excluding time parked for a human |
| `stages[].budget.maxTokens` | integer (≥1, ≤10000000000) |  |  | Input plus output tokens reported by the provider |

## Stages: kind `wait`

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stages[].kind` | "wait" | yes |  | Wait for an approval, an external event or a timer; the output is {outcome, data, by, at} |
| `stages[].wait` | one of (by `type`) | yes |  | What the stage waits for; it holds no executor, lease or admission slot |
| `stages[].wait.type` | "approval" | yes |  | A person approves or rejects, optionally filling a form |
| `stages[].wait.prompt` | object | yes |  | What the approver is asked (a template) |
| `stages[].wait.prompt.label` | string (1..200 chars) | yes |  | Short label shown in the builder and run page |
| `stages[].wait.prompt.text` | string (1..100000 chars) | yes |  | The prompt text, a template |
| `stages[].wait.form` | record<string, any> |  |  | JSON Schema of the approver's input (output.data) |
| `stages[].wait.timeoutMs` | integer (≥1000, ≤2592000000) |  |  | Give up after this long (an unattended run without one expires after 72 h) |
| `stages[].wait.onTimeout` | 'fail' \| 'complete' |  | `"fail"` | fail fails the stage (wait_timeout); complete completes it with outcome timeout (route on stages.<key>.output.outcome) |
| `stages[].wait.type` | "event" | yes |  | An external event: the deliver_event command or the per-wait callback URL |
| `stages[].wait.eventKey` | string (1..2000 chars) | yes |  | The event key to wait for (a string expression, for example concat('ci:', stages.push.output.sha)) |
| `stages[].wait.type` | "timer" | yes |  | A fixed delay |
| `stages[].wait.durationMs` | integer (≥1000, ≤2592000000) | yes |  | How long to wait |

## session (workflow.session, stages[].session)

A stage `session` is merged over the workflow `session`, field by field.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `session.model` | string (≤200 chars) |  |  | Model id; omitted means the provider or agent default |
| `session.harnessType` | 'copilot' \| 'claude-agent' \| 'codex' \| 'opencode' \| 'acp' |  |  | Agent provider; omitted routes by model, then the server default |
| `session.reasoningEffort` | 'low' \| 'medium' \| 'high' \| 'xhigh' \| 'max' \| 'ultra' |  |  | Reasoning effort |
| `session.contextTier` | 'default' \| 'long_context' |  |  | Context window tier |
| `session.maxTurns` | integer (≥1, ≤1000) |  |  | Turn cap per prompt |
| `session.provider` | object |  |  | Bring-your-own-key provider endpoint |
| `session.provider.name` | string (1..100 chars) | yes |  | Provider name |
| `session.provider.baseUrl` | string url (≤2000 chars) | yes |  | API base URL |
| `session.provider.apiKey` | string (1..500 chars) | yes |  | API key; must be a secretref: reference |
| `session.provider.model` | string (≤200 chars) |  |  | Model id at this provider |
| `session.agentRef` | string (1..128 chars) |  |  | Portable scope:slug reference of the agent driving the session |
| `session.agentOverrides` | object |  |  | Additive capability delta applied to the bound agent at this binding site |
| `session.agentOverrides.addSkillIds` | string (≤200 chars)[] (≤100) |  |  | Skills added to the agent |
| `session.agentOverrides.removeSkillIds` | string (≤200 chars)[] (≤100) |  |  | Agent skills removed |
| `session.agentOverrides.addMcpServerIds` | string (≤200 chars)[] (≤100) |  |  | MCP servers added to the agent |
| `session.agentOverrides.removeMcpServerIds` | string (≤200 chars)[] (≤100) |  |  | Agent MCP servers removed |
| `session.agentOverrides.tools` | object |  |  | Tool-group delta over the bound agent |
| `session.agentOverrides.tools.browser` | boolean |  |  | Integrated browser tools |
| `session.agentOverrides.tools.widgets` | boolean |  |  | Widget tools |
| `session.agentOverrides.tools.extensionAuthoring` | boolean |  |  | Extension authoring tools |
| `session.agentOverrides.tools.orchestration` | boolean |  |  | Orchestrator worker tools |
| `session.agentOverrides.tools.fileRead` | boolean |  |  | File read tools |
| `session.agentOverrides.tools.fileWrite` | boolean |  |  | File write tools |
| `session.agentOverrides.tools.shell` | boolean |  |  | Shell tools |
| `session.agentOverrides.tools.web` | boolean |  |  | Web fetch and search tools |
| `session.agentOverrides.tools.workflows` | boolean |  |  | Workflow tools: list, describe, run, check, respond to an approval, cancel |
| `session.agentOverrides.tools.workflowAuthoring` | boolean |  |  | Workflow authoring tools: guide, validate, plan, create a draft |
| `session.agentOverrides.runtime` | object |  |  | Runtime delta over the bound agent |
| `session.agentOverrides.runtime.model` | string (≤200 chars) |  |  | Model id |
| `session.agentOverrides.runtime.harnessType` | 'copilot' \| 'claude-agent' \| 'codex' \| 'opencode' \| 'acp' |  |  | Agent provider |
| `session.agentOverrides.runtime.reasoningEffort` | 'low' \| 'medium' \| 'high' \| 'xhigh' \| 'max' \| 'ultra' |  |  | Reasoning effort |
| `session.agentOverrides.runtime.contextTier` | 'default' \| 'long_context' |  |  | Context window tier |
| `session.agentOverrides.runtime.maxTurns` | integer (≥1, ≤1000) |  |  | Turn cap per prompt |
| `session.agentOverrides.runtime.permissionMode` | 'default' \| 'acceptEdits' \| 'plan' \| 'bypassPermissions' \| 'dontAsk' |  |  | Permission mode |
| `session.agentOverrides.runtime.defaultAgentMode` | 'auto' \| 'plan' |  |  | Default agent mode |
| `session.agentOverrides.appendInstructions` | string (≤16000 chars) |  |  | Text appended to the agent instructions |
| `session.agentOverrides.extraAllow` | string (≤200 chars)[] (≤200) |  |  | Extra tool names allowed |
| `session.agentOverrides.extraDeny` | string (≤200 chars)[] (≤200) |  |  | Extra tool names denied |
| `session.systemMessage` | object |  |  | System message |
| `session.systemMessage.mode` | 'append' \| 'replace' |  | `"append"` | Append to or replace the replaceable base message |
| `session.systemMessage.content` | string (≤100000 chars) | yes |  | Message text |
| `session.systemPromptAppend` | string (≤100000 chars) |  |  | Text appended to the system prompt |
| `session.planModeInstructions` | string (≤20000 chars) |  |  | Replaces the default plan-mode workflow text |
| `session.tools` | object |  |  | Tool allow and deny lists |

| `session.mcp.servers{}.headers` | record<string, string (≤4000 chars)> |  |  | Request headers; secret values must be secretref: references |
| `session.mcp.servers{}.command` | string (≤1000 chars) |  |  | Executable (stdio); a literal |
| `session.mcp.servers{}.args` | string (≤4000 chars)[] (≤64) |  |  | Literal arguments (stdio) |
| `session.mcp.servers{}.env` | record<string, string (≤4000 chars)> |  |  | Environment (stdio); secret values must be secretref: references |
| `session.mcp.servers{}.cwd` | string (≤1000 chars) |  |  | Working directory (stdio) |
| `session.mcp.servers{}.tools` | string (≤200 chars)[] (≤500) |  |  | Allow-list of tool names this server may expose |
| `session.mcp.servers{}.timeoutMs` | integer (≥0, ≤600000) |  |  | Per-call timeout |
| `session.mcp.servers{}.enabled` | boolean |  |  | False keeps the entry but does not start the server |
| `session.mcp.excludedIds` | string (≤200 chars)[] (≤200) |  |  | MCP server ids removed |
| `session.skills` | object |  |  | Skills |
| `session.skills.directories` | string (≤1000 chars)[] (≤100) |  |  | Extra skill directories |
| `session.skills.disabled` | string (≤200 chars)[] (≤500) |  |  | Skill names disabled |
| `session.customAgents` | object[] (≤50) |  |  | Inline sub-agents |
| `session.customAgents[].name` | string (1..120 chars) | yes |  | Sub-agent name |
| `session.customAgents[].description` | string (1..2000 chars) | yes |  | When the model should use this sub-agent |
| `session.customAgents[].instructions` | string (1..64000 chars) | yes |  | Sub-agent instructions |
| `session.customAgents[].tools` | string (≤200 chars)[] (≤200) |  |  | Tools the sub-agent may use |
| `session.permissionMode` | 'default' \| 'acceptEdits' \| 'plan' \| 'bypassPermissions' \| 'dontAsk' |  |  | Tool permission policy |
| `session.defaultAgentMode` | 'auto' \| 'plan' |  |  | Agent mode for each turn (auto or plan) |
| `session.browser` | object |  |  | Integrated browser configuration |
| `session.browser.enabled` | boolean |  |  | Whether the integrated browser is available |
| `session.browser.mode` | 'auto' \| 'native' \| 'screencast' |  |  | Rendering mode |
| `session.browser.visibility` | 'visible' \| 'headless' \| 'off' |  |  | Visibility (default headless) |
| `session.browser.headless` | boolean |  |  | Low-level headless switch; visibility wins |
| `session.browser.viewport` | object |  |  | Viewport size |
| `session.browser.viewport.width` | integer (≥320, ≤3840) | yes |  | Viewport width in pixels |
| `session.browser.viewport.height` | integer (≥240, ≤2160) | yes |  | Viewport height in pixels |
| `session.browser.allowedHosts` | string (1..200 chars)[] (≤100) |  |  | Host allow-list for navigation |
| `session.browser.persistProfile` | boolean |  |  | Keep the browser profile between sessions |
| `session.browser.screencastFps` | integer (≥1, ≤15) |  |  | Screencast frame rate |

| `session.browser.idlePauseMinutes` | integer (≥1, ≤120) |  |  | Pause the browser after this idle time |

## edges

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `edges[].from` | string `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,47}$` | yes |  | Key of the source stage |
| `edges[].to` | string `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,47}$` | yes |  | Key of the target stage |
| `edges[].on` | 'success' \| 'failure' \| 'completion' \| 'always' |  | `"success"` | success: source completed; failure: source failed; completion: completed or failed; always: any terminal state |
| `edges[].when` | string (1..2000 chars) |  |  | Boolean expression; false makes the edge inactive. May read parent.status |
| `edges[].handlesFailure` | boolean |  |  | Lets a completion or always edge count as handling a failure of the source |

## Stage error codes (`retry.retryOn`)

| Class | Codes |
|---|---|
| transient | `rate_limited`, `overloaded`, `provider_5xx`, `transport`, `provider_crashed`, `idle_timeout`, `attempt_timeout` |
| deterministic | `auth`, `model_not_found`, `quota_exhausted`, `context_overflow`, `max_turns`, `budget_exceeded`, `config_invalid`, `agent_not_found`, `agent_disabled`, `pre_run_hook_abort`, `rejected_by_human`, `pause_expired`, `condition_error`, `queue_timeout`, `check_launch_failed`, `check_failed`, `loop_body_failed`, `loop_exit_fail`, `loop_limit`, `loop_wall_clock`, `loop_carry_too_large`, `restore_failed`, `map_items_invalid`, `map_too_large`, `map_duplicate_item_key`, `map_tolerance_exceeded`, `mount_fork_failed`, `item_setup_failed`, `merge_conflict`, `merge_failed`, `map_winner_failed`, `expansion_invalid`, `expansion_failed`, `subworkflow_start_failed`, `subworkflow_output_drift`, `subworkflow_failed`, `wait_timeout` |
| repairable | `output_schema`, `validation_rule`, `judge_below_threshold`, `missing_artifact` |
| interrupted | `process_restart_unsafe`, `lease_expired` |
